title: ForgeCycle notification log record
description: One line of <git-common-dir>/forgecycle/observability/notifications.ndjson, the history of runs that needed an operator (ADR 0027). The command that owns a run appends a raised record when it leaves the run stopped for an operator; the command whose state save clears the stop appends a resolved record. Readers fold records by key: the first raised and the first resolved record of a key win, and lines that do not parse are skipped.

at.description: raised: when the stop was written to the run's state (its updated_at); resolved: when the stop was cleared

by.description: The full name of the command that wrote the record, for example task run or task approve

operation_id.description: The writing command's operation in the journal

item.description: raised only: the attention item, as GET /api/attention returns it. It never carries the stop reason.

next.description: The stop report's first suggested command

human.description: The first suggested command needs a human decision

late.description: raised only: written by a later command than the one that stopped the run, such as for an interrupted run

detected_at.description: raised only, with late: when the stop was recorded

key.description: resolved only: the raised item's key

outcome.description: resolved only: the run's state after the resolving command, or deleted when forgecycle prune removed it
